alignments.note: Conjunction rendered *And*.
Independent pronoun takes its own English pronoun; the vocative that follows keeps its own words.
Construct noun of the vocative address; no supplied *O* or *ye* is written here, so only *son* is placed.
Nomen rectum with the relational *of* (rule 19).
Adverb rendered *thus*.
Finite verb rendered *saith*.
No article morpheme stands in the phrase, so the ASV's supplied *the* belongs to the nominal expression it determines (rule 15) and joins the noun it stands before.
The frozen first-person suffix of אֲדֹנָי gets no separate English pronoun in the ASV's *the Lord Jehovah*.
Divine name rendered *Jehovah*.
Preposition rendered *unto*.
Construct noun; the rectum is a proper name with no article morpheme, so the *the* is supplied on the construct (rule 29).
Nomen rectum with *of* (rule 19).
Hebrew has no indefinite article, so the ASV's *An* belongs to the noun that licenses it (rule 15).
Fronted verb; the ASV reorders it after the resumed subject, so the unit is discontinuous from its Hebrew position under rule 25. Heads on the lexical verb.
Article takes the *the* written before its own noun.
The resumed noun; the ASV writes both occurrences, so neither is unrepresented.
Preposition rendered *upon*.
Numeral rendered *four*. The variant unit covering this token is underdetermined and its fallback remains among the readings the English permits, so rule 53 does not apply.

The ASV writes two *the*s: t027 stands before *land* and belongs to that word's article, so t023 is the supplied *the* on the construct (rule 29). The unit is discontinuous around the numeral under rule 25. A defensible alternative gives t023 to the numeral it stands before, but rule 29 places a supplied article on the construct of the phrase it determines.
Article takes the *the* standing before its own word (rule 29).
Nomen rectum with *of* (rule 19).

review_notes: The two supplied *the*s in *the four corners of the land* are placed by counting the ASV's articles against the one present article morpheme (rule 29).
Variant WLC.EZK.7.2.v001 is underdetermined and compatible with the base reading; nothing in rule 53 is engaged.
